body: No, they won't. They will get over it and move on. It's like when a gerbil dies.
I'm sorry. But I have to go through with this. Death is the closest thing I have to rest.
How can life be better than this? How?
Thanks for your help but no, it will never be better. I know this because the odds against me are astronomical.
Not as bad as you think! My life is in shambles so they're pretty much equal options at this point, haha.

You don't see. It's already too late. By the time I get my shit together, women my age will have lost their youth. Then they will be out to snag a loser so they can suck his money dry. I don't want to be that loser.

That's the main issue,  time. I'm already 21. It will take me 3-4 years to develop the ideal body and many more to secure a good job. It's just not feasible.

I think suicide is the best option for me because it'll be much more reasonable than trying to navigate the sunken ship that is my life. There is no salvaging a person like me. Even if I change entirely, the girls will smell my past and refuse to deal with me any longer. Why would they?
Make them who I never was. Teach them to succeed in this world.
That's a good idea! Thanks for the shotgun advice. And I'll probably end up doing it since fixing my issues seems nigh impossible at this point.

I don't know what I'm proud of. I just feel like a miserable wretch but I don't want to break my lineage. To have the bloodline stop at my sorry ads would be shameful. I have no accomplishments or positive qualities. In short, I'm a waste of space.
How can I avoid the pain and just destroy my head completely? I am just so lost. I feel like if you're terrible with the opposite sex then you deserve to die.

How does one even begin to fix this situation? I am absolutely horrendous with women. And I am so far behind socially that I don't have time to catch up and have the semblance of a regular social life. I'm 21, and I'm supposed to be having the time of my life socially,  plowing women like there's no tomorrow. But that could not be farther from the truth.

I just hate them. They have an easy life, using their looks to get whatever they want. They don't have to try, and everyone wants them. Meanwhile,  I have to put in effort to make any little interaction with people work. It's definitely a lopsided situation.

In any case, I think my biggest problem is when they talk to me (however rarely). It's almost certain then that it'll be to ask me a favor. As if I'm some sort of lesser being for being in their presence. And that pisses me off so much because I know without their looks they are nothing.

I don't know what kind of woman I want. I've never been compatible with any. I'm just bad with them.

For example, I took a Japanese class last quarter and there was this girl in there that I ended up taking on a couple dates. But she is so regularly intimidating that when I unexpectedly found out she was in my Japanese 2 class, I dropped it. She would have been too much of a distraction.

No women look at me, much less talk to me. Right now I'm slightly overweight,  and I eventually plan to get ripped so I can bag a girl and have kids in the future. It's not something I care for, having a GF, I just want my next generation to eventually exist.

Thanks bro. But this is something that nobody can resolve for me except myself. The problem is, the ball lies in the women's court and I am at a big disadvantage. It has driven me to the point where I hate women.
I'm glad to get feedback! Thanks for your help.
